name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2066: The console utility strip is display:flex with no flex-wrap, and a flex item never shrinks below its min-content width whatever flex:1 says - so seven buttons in a narrow sidebar column simply ran off the end. Measured at vw901 on the running console: btn-relaunch reaches x=922, btn-eagle 1034, btn-farmgate 1090 and btn-repair 1165, all past a 901px viewport, while document.scrollWidth stays 901 - so they were CLIPPED, not scrollable, and could not be pressed at all. v2059 added the seventh button and pushed repair furthest out, which is how it surfaced; the row had been overflowing for three buttons before that. The row now wraps and the whole-console overflow count at 901 goes from 4 to 0. Then the SAME class inside the repair panel squeezed restore dates from the game into four stacked lines - geometry said CLIPPED=none throughout, and only looking at it caught that.
